title: feat: validate shared memory segment limits before CPU offloading
body:
## Summary
- Adds a proactive check in `dispatch_with_map()` that validates OS shared memory segment limits (`shmmni`, `file-max`) before CPU offloading begins
- Counts the total number of tensors (parameters + buffers) across all CPU-offloaded modules and raises an `OSError` with actionable remediation if the limit would be exceeded
- Only runs in distributed mode, where `DistributedCPUCache` creates one shared memory segment per tensor via `share_memory_()`
